About Us
As the 1st computer science department in Hong Kong, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong currently hosts over 30 faculty members, including 1st Turing Award winner in Hong Kong, 8 ACM Fellows, 16 IEEE Fellows, and over 1400 students.
